usedFor: Roborabbit holds runs and tasks, and Microsoft Excel receives a row for each through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “Run Finished” in Roborabbit, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each finished run becomes a row, giving you a log you can sort.

watchOut: “New Run” and “Run Finished” in Roborabbit are polling, so rows land after a scheduled check.
